findings.reader: A tight, well-proportioned dated news piece: it explains image understanding and the app-maker-to-model connection before the headline can mislead, keeps the September 14 routing change as one bounded technical note, and leaves the reader with a specific checkable action. No failure families present; explain-back and a novel transfer scenario both succeed on the article's mechanism alone.
findings.facts: The artifact accurately reports DeepSeek's September 10 V4.1-Flash launch with native image understanding, Vercel's September 9 AI Gateway availability, and the scheduled September 14 deepseek-v4-pro routing change, while correctly holding the app-level consequence as dependent on each app maker's choices; no defects found.
